stem: A major high-stress canopy intervention is requested near a sensitive flowering transition while the crop is still recovering from an unrelated stress event. What is the strongest Technician II response?
choices: Execute immediately because the technique is on the normal calendar
Verify the work-order intent and authorization, flag recovery/stage risk, and seek clarification when the approved objective does not justify the added stress
Double the intervention so it only needs to be done once
rationale: Technician II executes approved advanced work but must integrate stage, vigor, recovery, and work-order intent. Significant risk or ambiguity should be clarified rather than normalized.
